content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RITES Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 20-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES) for hiring eligible professionals on a contract basis in Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies have been announced for various Individual Consultant posts including ICT Engineer, Construction Manager, Field Engineer, and Construction Supervisor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting date to apply for RITES Individual Consultant positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can start submitting their online applications from 25 September 2026 onwards through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the online application form is 20 October 2026. Make sure to complete your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for the RITES posts?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a Graduate in Engineering / Computer Science or Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Civil Engineering depending on the specific post requirements.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for RITES Individual Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is not exceeding 62 years for all the posts listed under this recruitment advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. How much is the application fee for RITES Various Posts 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee for all categories applying for this recruitment process is NIL, meaning candidates do not need to pay any fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these consultant roles?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Document Scrutiny/verification process followed by a Personal Interview conducted by the organization.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I submit my application for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested and eligible candidates are required to submit their applications online by visiting the official RITES website at http://www.rites.com.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a competitive salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,30,000 per month depending on the specific post applied for.
